This
 document out lines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed 
 on an annually bases as
 indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdallah Elsayed M, tested by Abd Alla 
 Mohamed at 28 Dec 2004, revised by quality control eng. Adel Abd EL kader 
 El Nagar at EDEPC, accepted by eng El Sayed Attiah, and approved by eng . Awad 
 Soliman Head Sector of Talkha p.s

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant, Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman, EDEPC admin and financial 
 inspection, quality control General Director and Supervisor of inspection and 
 quality control head sector .

items: A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Transformer isolation and proper grounding 
 on all its sides is required.

Wear your safety helmet, safety
 shoes, and safety belt when cleaning suspension Insulator.

There is a danger falling into the containment pit when working near large 
 transformer.

It is
 recommended to use only fiberglass (PVC) ladders when working in the
 switchyard.

Before starting the cleaning of all porcelain surfaces of all transformer
 wear your breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.

Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, 
 collect it and send to the dump.

Fix
 any oil leaks to prevent pollution and save money of wasted oil.

Oil
leaks to the ground have very bad impact on the environment, mainly on soil and ground water and eventually on the ecosystem, It takes only 
1 liter of Hydrocarbon spilled in an aquifer to
render 1,000,000 liters of potable water useless for human consumption

Safety
 helmet, safety belt, safety shoes, and complete 
 tool set,
Blower, screwdriver set, and digital multimeter.

Fine cloth for cleaning , 
 silicagel, 
 and fiberglass PVC
 ladder.

Portable
 earth for discharging,
Megger at least 5000 V and Turns ratio test Equipment.
Tan δ and DC resistance equipment.

Make visual inspection for painting and oil leakage . Adjust oil level if 
 necessary.
Check oil temperature and winding temperature.
Make visual inspection and audible inspection of all fans and its screen.
Check transformer control cabinet and use blower for cleaning it.
Check transformer OLTC cabinet and use blower for cleaning.
Check door gaskets of OLTC and Control Cabinet.

Check air dryer : change the silica gel if it is pink or white or regenerate 
 it. Adjust oil level in the trap of air dryer.
Check heating circuit of motor drive unit of OLTC.
Keep the transformer clean together with the neutral point Earthing resistor.
Check and inspect the good working of fire fighting system.
Remove rust spots and retouch the transformer with rust preventive paint.
Detect unusual noises and vibrations.
Check the tightening of low voltage connections and accessories connections.
Check oil level in conservator (add if necessary).
Take oil sample from main tank and OLTC compartment for analysis and test.

Perform the periodic maintenance of the OLTC after 6 years or after 100 000 
 tap changes which one is the earliest.

Check the good working of Buchholz relay and the protective relay of tap- 
 changer.

Perform 
 the transformer tests and compare to historical data :
 - Ratio test (lowest & highest and neutral tap position).
 - Insulation Resistance.
 - Cap dissipation factor (Tan δ)
 - DC resistance of Windings.

Put the transformer back into 
 normal operation

Introduction
